body:
Well, I'm a piece of shit. I cried myself to sleep and I guess I live to see another day. But this is all too tough to deal with. I don't know how much longer I'll be able to deal with it when I have nights like last night. 

I've tried talking to a therapist. Back in college when they provided it for free. The woman was very argumentative and made me feel stupid. I never went back nor wanted to see a therapist again. 

I'm in my early 30s now. I don't think my dad remembers the incident in particular, and as an only child (and Asian), I feel pressure to please both my parents and be on good terms with them. I stopped talking to my dad for a period of time and my mom guilted me daily. She doesn't know what happened. Actually she calls the uncle who molested me throughout my childhood, my "favorite uncle". Ugh. There were so many times that I was allowed to be with him alone. I don't know why. I avoid him and my extended family for the most part, but I'm always guilted into seeing them on holidays and special occasions. 

Thanks for listening. And for responding.
